comment: Hardened 0.39 on .NET 10, laid out as its hardened-web template lays out an application: Implementation/ is the library, whose module ImplementationLibrary holds every route, and each host's directory holds a project whose application module imports it under that host's attribute and starts it. container-h1 and container-h2 run Hardened's Kestrel host, which runs no ASP.NET Core pipeline. lambda-emulator runs Hardened's Lambda host as a Native AOT executable. Directory.Packages.props sets one version for each package across every project, and each project restores locked to its own packages.lock.json, so lockfile names the four that pin what the images run. Hardened publishes prerelease versions only. The suite is UnitTests/, xUnit v3 under [HardenedTest], and never reaches an image. upgrade is null because dotnet package update moves every package to its newest release, majors included, and nothing narrows it to patch and minor.

unsupported.sse.medium: Hardened's Lambda host answers buffered unless HARDENED_LAMBDA_RESPONSE_MODE is stream, so the events arrive as one body.
unsupported.stream.ndjson: Hardened's Lambda host answers buffered unless HARDENED_LAMBDA_RESPONSE_MODE is stream, so the rows arrive as one body.

client.writer: Hardened.Web.SourceGenerator 0.39.0-rc1000, which writes the document into Implementation's assembly, and HardenedOpenApiOutput, which reads it out after each compile
client.generator: Kiota 1.35.0, a .NET local tool that Client.csproj runs, the generator the hardened-web template's client project runs

noHandler.cors.preflight: Hardened's CORS filter answers the preflight for /cors/small before routing, with the policy [Cors<Shop>] names, and no handler runs.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: The routing table answers a path no route matches with 404 and no body.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: The routing table answers a method the path has no route for with 405, an Allow header naming the methods it has, and no body.

authorized.mechanism: Hardened's authorization: [AuthorizeGrants] on the route, checked against the grants a principal source of the application's own reads from the bearer token

baseline.builtin: The handler returns the text, and [Produces] names text/plain.

body.mechanism: Hardened's validation generator, which compiles the constraint attributes on ValidatedOrder into a check that runs before the handler. [ValidationMode] stops the first-error route at the first failure

cache.mechanism: Hardened's response cache, its filter put on each cache route with settings.json's lifetime, keyed by VaryByRoute or by the headers VaryByHeader names, over the in-memory store [HardenedMemoryResponseCache] registers

compressed.mechanism: [Compress] on the two routes, Hardened's response compression, at gzip's fastest level

cors.mechanism: Hardened's CORS filter with a policy registered from settings.json, which [Cors<Shop>] puts on the /cors route alone

errors.builtin: The routing table answers a miss with 404 and a method a route lacks with 405, the binder refuses a body it cannot read with a 400 ValidationError, and the items handlers return NotFound, each in Hardened's own form.

etag.builtin: [ConditionalGet] on each route hashes the answer with SHA-256 into ETag and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304.

forms.builtin: [FromForm] binds query.many's model from the urlencoded fields, and two fields and the IFormFile from the multipart body.

headers.builtin: [FromHeader] binds each header by name, the account as an int.

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/{id:int}, the id bound as an int. The GET route answers HEAD, and Hardened drops the body.

json.mechanism: A source-generated JsonSerializerContext, registered as an IJsonTypeInfoResolver, which Hardened's serializers ask ahead of reflection

middleware.mechanism: [Layers], a filter attribute that puts four or sixteen no-op filters on the route

parameters.builtin: Path tokens bound as ints by name.

query.builtin: [FromQueryString] binds page by name, and query.many's eight values as one model.

sse.builtin: [ServerSentEvents] frames each item the handler's IAsyncEnumerable yields as one event and flushes it.

static.mechanism: Hardened.Web.StaticContent over the payload directory, which an IStaticContentSource of the application's own answers under /static

stream.builtin: A handler that returns IAsyncEnumerable is written as NDJSON, one line per item, each flushed.

template.mechanism: A RazorBlade view that [Output<T>] names, on the base class [Enable<RazorTemplates>] generates
